title: Essex to Yorkshire

kit: Insta360 Ace Pro 2 — flip screen, high frame rate, voice control
Selfie stick — keep it short, it shows in shot
AirPods as mic — test first; camera mics as backup
2–3 spare batteries or a USB-C car charger
preTrip: Book a room near Bakewell for Sunday night — Bank Holiday, fills fast
Charge every battery and your AirPods
Test the AirPods as a mic with the camera
Set phone alarms for Saturday's "leave by" times
goldenRule: Never film while driving. Mount the camera before you move; do pieces-to-camera parked.

lavenham.name: Lavenham
facts: Point at how wonky it all is — the timber was used unseasoned, so it warped as it dried
600 years ago this was one of England's richest towns, all on wool
De Vere House was Godric's Hollow in Harry Potter

film: Walking piece-to-camera down a crooked street
Hero shot up at a crooked house

stamford.name: Stamford
facts: All one honey-coloured limestone — that's why it's so harmonious
England's first-ever Conservation Area, 1967
It looks like a film set because it is one — Pride & Prejudice (2005)

film: Quick light lunch — protect the schedule
Walking piece-to-camera on a stone street
Hero shot of a spire above the rooftops

lincoln.name: Lincoln
lincoln.angle: The big one — and a hill
facts: Steep Hill — make a joke of the climb
The cathedral was the tallest building in the world for over 200 years, until its spire fell in 1548
The castle holds an original 1215 Magna Carta

routeCard.note: Park near the cathedral so the loop runs downhill — the climb back up Steep Hill is the catch.

film: Wide of the cathedral's west front
Hero shot back down Steep Hill

york.name: York
facts: Lean into the solo tone — calmer, more reflective
The Shambles is said to have inspired Diagon Alley
The most complete city walls in England — walk a stretch on camera
A short honest reflection somewhere quiet: how the trip's going

routeCard.note: Driving inside the walls is slow. Park at the edge; the bus drops you in the centre.
routeCard.trailingNote: The City Walls join by the Minster at Bootham Bar — climb up for an elevated walk.

film: Walking piece-to-camera up on the City Walls
Leave by 2:00 PM to reach the Peak in daylight

bakewell.name: Bakewell
facts: The Bakewell pudding and the tart are different things — the pudding is the original
Buy one, try it on camera, react honestly

routeCard.note: Type your accommodation address in once booked. Buttons pin Bakewell town.

castleton.name: Castleton & Winnats Pass
facts: This limestone formed in a tropical sea — it was all underwater once
Mam Tor, the "Shivering Mountain" — its old road was abandoned in 1979 as the hill kept slipping
Castleton is the only place on earth you find Blue John stone

routeCard.walkLeadNote: These three are short drives apart, not a walk.

film: In-car B-roll through Winnats — camera mounted
Your closing sign-off — last line on camera

talkTipbox: You're not presenting — you're telling a mate about your trip. Say what you're about to do, do it, then react. Keep each clip 20–40 seconds. Fluffing your words is fine; pause and go again.
goldenRules: Film more than you think you need
Say the place name on camera at every stop
Get the establishing shot the moment you arrive
Talk like a person, not a tour guide
outro: Safe travels, Ivan — the footage is in the bag.
